title: Replace copyDirRecursive shell-out with fs.cpSync
description: Eliminated the last execSync shell dependency in the update module by replacing xcopy/cp-R with fs.cpSync, and added perform.test.ts.

steps.title: Removed child_process import
steps.description: The import { execSync } from 'node:child_process' was removed entirely. After replacing copyDirRecursive, no code in perform.ts calls execSync. The cpSync function was added to the node:fs import on line 3.

steps.title: copyDirRecursive now uses fs.cpSync
steps.description: The function body was replaced from execSync with platform-conditional xcopy/cp-R to a single cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true }) call. This is cross-platform, in-process, and has no external binary dependency. The function signature and JSDoc are unchanged.

steps.title: safeRename EXDEV fallback is the sole caller
steps.description: safeRename calls copyDirRecursive at line 48 when renameSync throws EXDEV (cross-filesystem). The try/catch at line 158 in performStagedUpdate catches any errors from the swap phase including copy failures, preserving the fail-closed behavior.

steps.title: getInstallRoot tests
steps.description: Two tests verify getInstallRoot() returns a valid path: it resolves to an existing directory, and the directory contains package.json. This validates the import.meta.url resolution logic.

steps.title: Static module structure verification
steps.description: Reads the perform.ts source file and asserts it does NOT contain execSync or child_process, and DOES contain cpSync. This is a guard against regression — if someone re-adds a shell dependency, this test will fail.

steps.title: cpSync-based directory copy test
steps.description: Creates a nested directory structure matching the update payload layout (dist/, skill-content/, package.json, build-metadata.json), copies via cpSync (same API call as copyDirRecursive), and verifies all files exist with correct content.
